definitions.explanation: Acting or existing as distinct units, not together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{願|ねが}いします→願う：02387_negau⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
{別々|べつべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{別々|べつべつ} is a reduplication of ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate; different).

USAGE:
- {別々|べつべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (separate ~)
- {別々|べつべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (separately; do ~ separately)
- {別々|べつべつ}だ (are separate)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {別々|べつべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧ (live separately)
- {別々|べつべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}する→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (act separately)
- ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (separate checks)
- {別々|べつべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (separate paths)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別|べつ}に→別に：01132_betsuni⟧ (not particularly; separately)
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧ (each person; individually)
- ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧ (each; respectively)

{別々|べつべつ} emphasizes the separateness of two or more things, while ⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧ emphasizes individual differences.
